scope: Proposition 5.1 (Multiscale partition) of the manuscript “The higher-dimensional Erdős distinct-distances conjecture” (preprints/The-higher-dimensional-Erdos-distinct-distances-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 166 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37f6355365a18510), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are s∗ → ∞ and partitions of all but o(N) sample points into a core and non-core pieces with the following properties. 1. The core is simultaneously isolated by equations of a degree L such that EL2 = o(N). 2. Each non-core piece has a dyadic width s = 2−a log B ≥ s∗ and size n = N exp(−o(s)). Its path has d proper hypersurface cuts. Along any sequence of pieces, after passing to a subsequence, their normalized cut times converge to −1 ≤ b1 ≤ · · · ≤ bd ≤ 1, max i |bi| ≥ 1 2. The degree of cut i is at most Di exp(o(s)), where Di = B exp(bis). 3. Let b lie strictly between consecutive distinct limiting cut times, and let j = #{i : bi < b} and l = d − j. At each point of the piece the current system is pure of local dimension l. Uniformly over polynomials of degree O(Ts(b)), the number of points where such a polynomial vanishes but contains none of the local carriers is o(n). The same assertion holds before the first cut whenever Ts(b) ≥ 1 and b < b1, and it is automatic after the last cut. The assertions about error terms and negligible proportions hold along every sequence of pieces. In particular, a violating choice of one piece at each index is not permitted.
